verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit's FAQ states that it never uses customer code for model training, and that neither it nor its model providers (OpenAI, Anthropic) train on your code. That protection is the default, with no opt-out needed. Further controls are documented: retention settings for code-related data, a separate setting for model output logging, and self-hosted Enterprise deployment where you can opt out of all data retention. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the no-training policy, explicit coverage of non-code data (chat, learnings) under the no-training guarantee, and contractual/DPA-level documentation.
